paragraphs: Rabbi Bun bar Kahana — Bava Batra, chapter 8, halakha 8.

Rav Mari, son of Rav Kahana: Bava Kamma 91a. Rabbah bar Kahana: the end of the introduction to Eichah Rabbah; Hyman identifies him as Rabbi Abba bar Kahana. Shimon bar Kahana, a Tanna: Tosefta Sheviit, chapter 4.

notes.text: The Abba initials are expanded from the connected Kahana list. The notice separately preserves Kohen in Chanina’s patronym.
